Ruling: batch #7 item 1 · letter B′ · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-23T16:28:30Z

**What B′ is** (the card's B, narrowed by the maintainer's own words in the director thread; the letters A / B / C as filed and the D「发布对象」 variant the director offered at 16:10 were not chosen):

1. **Declaration stays as it is.** An installable app declares what it depends on in `ManifestSchema.dependencies` (`{ packageId: versionRange }`, manifest.zod.ts); the save door's closure already honours the declared packages' objects (`list-view-object-outside-closure`, #24630 / #24670 / #24703), so cross-app references need no new reference mechanism and no owner-side「published object」flag.
2. **Pre-install check, and only that gate.** Installing an app checks every declared dependency: the package is installed in the tenant and its version satisfies the range; otherwise the install is refused with a clear message (「请先安装 HotCRM 6.x」). This fills the `dependency_missing` category that `AppCompatibilityCheckSchema` (`packages/spec/src/system/app-install.zod.ts`) already reserves and that today has no producer.
3. **Deferred, written into the ADR as explicit later items, not implemented now:** uninstall protection (refusing to uninstall a depended-on app), upgrade interception (blocking an upgrade of the depended-on app that would leave a dependant's range), multi-package topological install / cascade install, an owner-side publish marker restricting which objects may be referenced, and any marketplace-level version negotiation.
4. **Permissions unchanged:** a referencing app's users see the referenced app's records under the referenced app's own sharing rules; a dependency opens the reference, not the data. Record-level semantics stay an open section in the ADR, decided with the first consumer.

**The maintainer's reasoning, verbatim, for the ADR author** (director thread, 2026-10-23):
> 25403 如果按照包依赖的方式，整个开发会复杂很多，如果每个应用包是单独安装的，有其他方式把数据串起来吗 (16:10:20Z)
> 往往需要引用的数据并不多，可能就几个对象 (16:10:38Z)
> 包依赖本身没问题，也就是说如果 psa 依赖 crm, 安装psa 之前先检测crm有没有，没有就禁止安装，这个有必要嘛 (16:20:28Z)
> 如果这样，hotcrm 岂不是真实的可以分拆出很多模块 (16:25:59Z) / 而每个包可以独立安装 (16:26:18Z)
> 同意 (16:28:30Z — on the director's recommendation B′ and the suggested order below)

**Workload of the chosen letter:** one ADR by the `domain:spec` seat (S, half a day to a day): the contract above; ADR-0028 D4 rewritten to「no cross-app reference without a declared dependency」; a cross-reference in ADR-0019 (text unchanged, ADR-0130's recording convention); the deferred gates listed by name; the open permission section; the manifest `dependencies` record and the marketplace `PackageDependencySchema` array (`package-version.zod.ts`) aligned. Then one runtime card for the pre-install check (XS–S) with the console's refusal text, plus docs. The first consumer scenario the ADR should name is a HotCRM module shipping on its own (hotcrm `docs/architecture/module-split-plan.md`, the 2026-09-14 shape: sales app + service / revenue / marketing; `revenue` first per ADR-0130 §1.3(c)); until the check lands, composite products keep shipping as one artifact under ADR-0130. The card's premise 6 is answered: nothing at install reads `manifest.dependencies` today (`dependency_missing` is an enum only; `packages.ts` validates the key's shape; `core/dependency-resolver.ts` serves kernel plugins), which is exactly the gap item 2 closes.

Labels: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; the `domain:spec` seat claims and drafts (裁不派). Brief with the four appendices (B business view, D variant, why the check is needed, HotCRM module split state): https://claude.ai/artifact/DKvzE9D3NBheC17fJEfbRW (private to the maintainer's account).

From `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 · `os-elon-musk` · session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT` · 2026-10-23T16:46Z

Two inputs for the ADR this card's ruling (B′, `6369704387`) asks for. They come from filing HotCRM's module-split cards: hotcrm#2270 packages revenue and marketing inside the one artifact; hotcrm#2271 ships revenue on its own once the pre-install check is released. This is information for the drafting seat. HotCRM does not rule on either point.

1. **Namespace across artifacts.**
   - Every HotCRM package declares `namespace: 'crm'` (`src/sales/index.ts:76`, `src/service/index.ts:151`). ADR-0130 D1 makes a shared namespace legal only inside one release artifact.
   - The install gate throws `NamespaceConflictError` for a non-co-owner package whose namespace is already installed (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:5942`). ADR-0048 D2 says the gate still refuses to co-install the two.
   - So a revenue module published as its own artifact would be refused next to HotCRM, unless the new ADR addresses it: a co-owner declaration across artifacts, the deferred owner field from ADR-0130 D6/D8, or something else.
   - B′ defers an owner-side publish marker, which is a different question and does not cover this.
   - hotcrm#2271 lists this as its first premise and forbids renaming objects to get around it. If settling it needs a product trade-off, it is this lane's `needs-user-decision`.
2. **objectstack#14488 is closed `not_planned` (2026-09-12).**
   - Its ruling (`5645322259`) says a module carved out as its own artifact ships its own permission sets, and that the card is not reopened for that. Its survey (`5623464256`) measured that module-owned sets already ship.
   - ADR-0130's *What was NOT decided* section still lists #14488 as "filed, not decided". That line is stale.
   - hotcrm#2271 therefore carries "permission sets travel with the module" as HotCRM-side work, not as a platform blocker.

Ruling: batch #8 item 2 · letter A · maintainer 「同意 #8」 2026-10-24T00:40:55Z

Second decision for the B′ ADR, raised by comment 6370024454 and objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2271 premise 1: a standalone revenue artifact keeps `namespace: 'crm'`, while today's install gate (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` ~5929–5942) refuses a package whose namespace an installed non-co-owner owns; co-ownership is proven only within one artifact (ADR-0130 D1) and the owner field is deferred (D8).

Chosen **A — dependency-declared co-ownership**: a package that declares `dependencies` on an installed package X and uses X's namespace is treated as X's co-owner at the install gate. One-way: the dependent gains nothing on X's side, and X never declares dependencies on its modules. The ADR-0130 D3 pair holds — the per-object-name uniqueness check now spans those co-owners across artifacts. No new manifest field. Workload: objectql S (one more source for `coOwners`, plus a test), riding with the B′ runtime pre-install card. Not chosen: B (end D8's deferral with an owner / publisher field aligned to `publisherOrgId` — it remains the later superset and needs no undo of A), C (rename module objects — refused, ADR-0129; hotcrm#2271 ⛔).

For the `domain:spec` seat drafting the B′ ADR: add this as its own decision (「声明依赖即命名空间共有，单向，D3 对象名唯一检查跨发布物同行」), state it as a one-way door whose in-tenant trust is the administrator's install choice, and reword ADR-0130 D8's deferral to end at marketplace publishing (ADR-0048's 2026-08-08 addendum, still Proposed) rather than at a module's first standalone artifact. Director brief: https://claude.ai/artifact/DAfU6jpbkvmgLpZUgu5RJM (card 2).
